copy.curiosityHook: Can an escaped convict, the hapless cop he held at gunpoint, and an accidental hostage survive a chaotic police chase without driving one another mad?
copy.description: After breaking out of prison, a con man hijacks a bumbling police officer's car and unwittingly ropes a nitpicking civilian along for the ride, launching an unpredictable getaway.
copy.vibeSummary: Light, funny road comedy with an easy pace, built around mismatched companions and accessible humor.
copy.whyWatch: This Italian comedy delivers steady laughs and lively odd-couple banter, carried by three mismatched personalities trapped together on the run.

allowedMaterial: A funny con man breaking out of jail
Seizing a bumbling cop's car at gunpoint
Unwittingly taking a nitpicking civilian hostage
The trio on the run from the police
Lighthearted comedy tone and blossoming companionship premise
excludedMaterial: Final fate of the con man or hostages
Third-act set pieces or final arrests
